findings.issue: Figure 6.1’s workload box still labels 'concurrency' as a workload metric, while the surrounding text and the figure caption classify concurrency as a serving-side derived quantity, not an offered workload input. The caption calls this an erratum in the figure art, but the figure itself remains incorrect.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate Figure 6.1 so the workload box contains only rps and token profile, and move concurrency to the serving side or remove it from the figure.

findings.fix_instruction: Relabel the 2 s line in Figure 6.2 as 'p95 TTFT ceiling = 2 s' and keep the 1.2 s design budget distinct in the caption or annotation.
